name: Peter Thiel
role: Entrepreneur and investor; co-founder of PayPal and Palantir
summary: A self-described libertarian, skeptical of democracy and of high taxes and welfare, who backs national conservatism and Donald Trump, opposes 'stupid wars' and global governance, and argues that technological stagnation is the central problem.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: In his 2025 lectures described a total one-world government as closer to the Antichrist than environmental, nuclear or bioweapon threats. In 2007 he contrasted Echelon with 'the United Nations, filled with interminable and inconclusive parliamentary debates.'

free-trade.rationale: In the late 2010s criticized economically liberal attitudes toward free trade while supporting national conservatism.

nation-first.rationale: Supports national conservatism and in 2025 called for a drastic reset of economic relations with China on geopolitical grounds.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: 'Instead of going to Mars, we have invaded the Middle East... It's time to end the era of stupid wars and rebuild our country' (2016). He wrote that a Christian statesman 'would be wise, in every close case, to side with peace' (2007).

limit-growth.rationale: Has long argued that technological stagnation and slow growth are a central problem, and criticized 'green quietism' (2021).

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Called Greta Thunberg one of the 'legionnaires of the Antichrist' (2025), while treating environmental degradation as a credible threat.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Frames the future as 'a deadly race between politics and technology' and looks to technologies such as seasteading as an escape from politics.
